description: Displays a menu to the user — such as a set of actions or functions — triggered by a button.

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The root. open: renders it open; modal: false keeps the page usable while
  # it is open (no scroll lock, nothing made inert). Placement lives on
  # DropdownMenuContent (side:, align:, side_offset:, align_offset:).
  # options: {placement: "bottom-start"} still works as a fallback for side:
  # and align:; options[:strategy] is ignored (the menu is a top-layer popover).
  class DropdownMenu < Base
    def initialize(open: false, modal: true, options: {}, **attrs)
      @open = open
      @modal = modal
      @options = options
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {
          slot: "dropdown-menu",
          controller: "ruby-ui--dropdown-menu",
          ruby_ui__dropdown_menu_open_value: @open.to_s,
          ruby_ui__dropdown_menu_modal_value: @modal.to_s,
          ruby_ui__dropdown_menu_options_value: @options.to_json
        }
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # A toggle in the menu (role menuitemcheckbox). Activating it flips
  # aria-checked, keeps the menu open and fires ruby-ui--dropdown-menu:change
  # with {checked} in the detail.
  class DropdownMenuCheckboxItem < Base
    ITEM = [
      "group/dropdown-menu-checkbox-item relative flex cursor-default items-center gap-2 rounded-sm py-1.5 pr-8 pl-2 text-sm outline-hidden select-none",
      "focus:bg-accent focus:text-accent-foreground focus:**:text-accent-foreground",
      "data-disabled:pointer-events-none data-disabled:opacity-50 data-inset:pl-8",
      "[&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4"
    ].freeze

    def initialize(checked: false, inset: false, disabled: false, **)
      @checked = checked
      @inset = inset
      @disabled = disabled
      super(**)
    end

    def view_template(&block)
      div(**attrs) do
        render DropdownMenuItemIndicator.new(kind: :checkbox)
        yield if block
      end
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "menuitemcheckbox",
        tabindex: "-1",
        aria: {checked: @checked.to_s, disabled: (@disabled ? "true" : nil)},
        data: {
          slot: "dropdown-menu-checkbox-item",
          inset: @inset,
          disabled: @disabled,
          action: "click->ruby-ui--dropdown-menu#activate pointermove->ruby-ui--dropdown-menu#hover pointerleave->ruby-ui--dropdown-menu#leave"
        },
        class: ITEM
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The menu. A native popover (top layer) placed by Floating UI next to the
  # trigger, as wide as the trigger (at least min-w-32). side:/align: pick the
  # placement, side_offset:/align_offset: the gap, with the defaults of
  # shadcn's DropdownMenuContent (bottom, start, 4, 0).
  class DropdownMenuContent < Base
    SIDES = %i[top right bottom left].freeze
    ALIGNS = %i[start center end].freeze

    def initialize(side: nil, align: nil, side_offset: 4, align_offset: 0, **)
      @side = (side && SIDES.include?(side.to_sym)) ? side.to_sym : nil
      @align = (align && ALIGNS.include?(align.to_sym)) ? align.to_sym : nil
      @side_offset = side_offset
      @align_offset = align_offset
      super(**)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "menu",
        tabindex: "-1",
        popover: "manual",
        data: {
          slot: "dropdown-menu-content",
          # Kept in sync with data-open/data-closed for CSS that targets data-[state=...].
          state: "closed",
          closed: "",
          ruby_ui__dropdown_menu_target: "content",
          action: "keydown->ruby-ui--dropdown-menu#keydown",
          preferred_side: @side,
          align: @align,
          side_offset: @side_offset,
          align_offset: @align_offset
        },
        class: [
          "fixed inset-auto m-0 border-0 z-50 w-(--anchor-width) min-w-32 max-h-(--available-height) origin-(--transform-origin)",
          "overflow-x-hidden overflow-y-auto outline-none",
          "bg-popover text-popover-foreground ring-1 ring-foreground/10 rounded-md p-1 shadow-md duration-100",
          "data-open:animate-in data-open:fade-in-0 data-open:zoom-in-95",
          "data-closed:animate-out data-closed:fade-out-0 data-closed:zoom-out-95 data-closed:fill-mode-forwards",
          "data-[side=bottom]:slide-in-from-top-2 data-[side=left]:slide-in-from-right-2",
          "data-[side=right]:slide-in-from-left-2 data-[side=top]:slide-in-from-bottom-2"
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

require "securerandom"

module RubyUI
  # A group of items (role group), named by the DropdownMenuLabel inside it.
  class DropdownMenuGroup < Base
    def initialize(id: nil, **)
      @id = id || "dropdown-menu-group-#{SecureRandom.hex(4)}"
      super(id: @id, **)
    end

    # The children are captured first, so aria-labelledby only points at a
    # DropdownMenuLabel that actually rendered.
    def view_template(&block)
      previous = context[:ruby_ui_dropdown_menu_group]
      names = context[:ruby_ui_dropdown_menu_group] = {label_id: "#{@id}-label"}
      body = block ? capture(&block) : ""
      group_attrs = names[:labelledby] ? mix({aria: {labelledby: names[:labelledby]}}, attrs) : attrs
      div(**group_attrs) { raw(safe(body)) }
    ensure
      context[:ruby_ui_dropdown_menu_group] = previous
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "group",
        data: {slot: "dropdown-menu-group"}
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # An action. A div by default; href: makes it a link. variant: :destructive
  # paints it red, inset: lines it up with items that have an indicator,
  # disabled: keeps it focusable but never activated.
  # as: :div (kept for compatibility) renders a div even with href:.
  class DropdownMenuItem < Base
    ITEM = [
      "group/dropdown-menu-item relative flex cursor-default items-center gap-2 rounded-sm px-2 py-1.5 text-sm outline-hidden select-none",
      "focus:bg-accent focus:text-accent-foreground not-data-[variant=destructive]:focus:**:text-accent-foreground",
      "data-disabled:pointer-events-none data-disabled:opacity-50 data-inset:pl-8",
      "data-[variant=destructive]:text-destructive data-[variant=destructive]:focus:bg-destructive/10",
      "dark:data-[variant=destructive]:focus:bg-destructive/20 data-[variant=destructive]:focus:text-destructive",
      "data-[variant=destructive]:*:[svg]:text-destructive",
      "[&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4"
    ].freeze

    def initialize(href: nil, as: nil, variant: :default, inset: false, disabled: false, **)
      @href = href
      @as = as&.to_sym
      @variant = (variant.to_sym == :destructive) ? :destructive : :default
      @inset = inset
      @disabled = disabled
      super(**)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      link? ? a(**attrs, &) : div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def link?
      return false if @as == :div

      !@href.nil? || @as == :a
    end

    def default_attrs
      {
        href: (link? ? @href : nil),
        role: "menuitem",
        tabindex: "-1",
        aria: {disabled: (@disabled ? "true" : nil)},
        data: {
          slot: "dropdown-menu-item",
          variant: @variant,
          inset: @inset,
          disabled: @disabled,
          action: "click->ruby-ui--dropdown-menu#activate pointermove->ruby-ui--dropdown-menu#hover pointerleave->ruby-ui--dropdown-menu#leave"
        },
        class: ITEM
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The check of a DropdownMenuCheckboxItem / DropdownMenuRadioItem, shown only
  # while the item is aria-checked="true". Rendered by those items.
  class DropdownMenuItemIndicator < Base
    # Full class names, so Tailwind finds them when it scans the source.
    SHOW_WHEN_CHECKED = {
      checkbox: "group-aria-checked/dropdown-menu-checkbox-item:flex",
      radio: "group-aria-checked/dropdown-menu-radio-item:flex"
    }.freeze
    SLOTS = {
      checkbox: "dropdown-menu-checkbox-item-indicator",
      radio: "dropdown-menu-radio-item-indicator"
    }.freeze

    def initialize(kind:, **)
      @kind = kind
      super(**)
    end

    def view_template
      span(**attrs) do
        svg(
          xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
          viewbox: "0 0 24 24",
          fill: "none",
          stroke: "currentColor",
          stroke_width: "2",
          stroke_linecap: "round",
          stroke_linejoin: "round",
          aria_hidden: "true"
        ) { |s| s.path(d: "M20 6 9 17l-5-5") }
      end
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        aria: {hidden: "true"},
        data: {slot: SLOTS.fetch(@kind)},
        class: ["pointer-events-none absolute right-2 hidden items-center justify-center", SHOW_WHEN_CHECKED.fetch(@kind)]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # A heading. Inside a DropdownMenuGroup the first label names the group
  # (aria-labelledby) and its own text is hidden from the accessibility tree.
  class DropdownMenuLabel < Base
    def initialize(inset: false, **)
      @inset = inset
      super(**)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      names = context[:ruby_ui_dropdown_menu_group]
      # Only the first label names the group; later ones stay plain text.
      return div(**attrs, &) if names.nil? || names[:labelledby]

      id = attrs[:id] || names[:label_id]
      names[:labelledby] ||= id
      div(**mix({aria: {hidden: "true"}}, attrs.merge(id: id)), &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "dropdown-menu-label", inset: @inset},
        class: "text-muted-foreground px-2 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium data-inset:pl-8"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Groups DropdownMenuRadioItems: checking one unchecks the others. Like
  # DropdownMenuGroup, a DropdownMenuLabel inside it names the group.
  class DropdownMenuRadioGroup < DropdownMenuGroup
    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "group",
        data: {slot: "dropdown-menu-radio-group"}
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # One choice of a DropdownMenuRadioGroup (role menuitemradio). Activating it
  # checks it, unchecks its siblings, keeps the menu open and fires
  # ruby-ui--dropdown-menu:change with {checked, value} in the detail.
  class DropdownMenuRadioItem < Base
    ITEM = [
      "group/dropdown-menu-radio-item relative flex cursor-default items-center gap-2 rounded-sm py-1.5 pr-8 pl-2 text-sm outline-hidden select-none",
      "focus:bg-accent focus:text-accent-foreground focus:**:text-accent-foreground",
      "data-disabled:pointer-events-none data-disabled:opacity-50 data-inset:pl-8",
      "[&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4"
    ].freeze

    def initialize(value: nil, checked: false, inset: false, disabled: false, **)
      @value = value
      @checked = checked
      @inset = inset
      @disabled = disabled
      super(**)
    end

    def view_template(&block)
      div(**attrs) do
        render DropdownMenuItemIndicator.new(kind: :radio)
        yield if block
      end
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "menuitemradio",
        tabindex: "-1",
        aria: {checked: @checked.to_s, disabled: (@disabled ? "true" : nil)},
        data: {
          slot: "dropdown-menu-radio-item",
          value: @value,
          inset: @inset,
          disabled: @disabled,
          action: "click->ruby-ui--dropdown-menu#activate pointermove->ruby-ui--dropdown-menu#hover pointerleave->ruby-ui--dropdown-menu#leave"
        },
        class: ITEM
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class DropdownMenuSeparator < Base
    def view_template
      div(**attrs)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "separator",
        aria_orientation: "horizontal",
        data: {slot: "dropdown-menu-separator", orientation: "horizontal"},
        class: "bg-border -mx-1 my-1 h-px"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Shows an item's key combination. It only displays the keys: binding them is up to you.
  class DropdownMenuShortcut < Base
    def view_template(&)
      span(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "dropdown-menu-shortcut"},
        class: "ml-auto text-xs tracking-widest text-muted-foreground group-focus/dropdown-menu-item:text-accent-foreground"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

require "securerandom"

module RubyUI
  # A submenu: one DropdownMenuSubTrigger and its DropdownMenuSubContent,
  # tied together by ids (aria-controls / aria-labelledby).
  class DropdownMenuSub < Base
    def initialize(id: nil, **)
      @id = id || "dropdown-menu-sub-#{SecureRandom.hex(4)}"
      super(**)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      previous = context[:ruby_ui_dropdown_menu_sub]
      context[:ruby_ui_dropdown_menu_sub] = @id
      div(**attrs, &)
    ensure
      context[:ruby_ui_dropdown_menu_sub] = previous
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {data: {slot: "dropdown-menu-sub"}}
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The submenu. A native popover placed next to its DropdownMenuSubTrigger,
  # with the defaults of shadcn's DropdownMenuSubContent (right, start, 0, -3).
  class DropdownMenuSubContent < Base
    SIDES = DropdownMenuContent::SIDES
    ALIGNS = DropdownMenuContent::ALIGNS

    def initialize(side: :right, align: :start, side_offset: 0, align_offset: -3, **)
      @side = SIDES.include?(side.to_sym) ? side.to_sym : :right
      @align = ALIGNS.include?(align.to_sym) ? align.to_sym : :start
      @side_offset = side_offset
      @align_offset = align_offset
      super(**)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      div(**with_sub_ids(attrs), &)
    end

    private

    # The ids come from the DropdownMenuSub around it, known only while
    # rendering. They win over a caller's id:, so the trigger's
    # aria-controls always points here.
    def with_sub_ids(given)
      id = context[:ruby_ui_dropdown_menu_sub]
      return given unless id

      given.merge(id: "#{id}-content", aria: (given[:aria] || {}).merge(labelledby: "#{id}-trigger"))
    end

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "menu",
        tabindex: "-1",
        popover: "manual",
        data: {
          slot: "dropdown-menu-sub-content",
          state: "closed",
          closed: "",
          preferred_side: @side,
          align: @align,
          side_offset: @side_offset,
          align_offset: @align_offset
        },
        class: [
          "fixed inset-auto m-0 border-0 z-50 w-auto min-w-[96px] max-h-(--available-height) origin-(--transform-origin)",
          "overflow-x-hidden overflow-y-auto outline-none",
          "bg-popover text-popover-foreground ring-1 ring-foreground/10 rounded-md p-1 shadow-lg duration-100",
          "data-open:animate-in data-open:fade-in-0 data-open:zoom-in-95",
          "data-closed:animate-out data-closed:fade-out-0 data-closed:zoom-out-95 data-closed:fill-mode-forwards",
          "data-[side=bottom]:slide-in-from-top-2 data-[side=left]:slide-in-from-right-2",
          "data-[side=right]:slide-in-from-left-2 data-[side=top]:slide-in-from-bottom-2"
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The item that opens a submenu: on hover, click, Enter, Space or ArrowRight.
  class DropdownMenuSubTrigger < Base
    def initialize(inset: false, disabled: false, **)
      @inset = inset
      @disabled = disabled
      super(**)
    end

    def view_template(&block)
      div(**with_sub_ids(attrs)) do
        yield if block
        chevron_right_icon
      end
    end

    private

    # lucide chevron-right
    def chevron_right_icon
      svg(
        xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
        viewbox: "0 0 24 24",
        fill: "none",
        stroke: "currentColor",
        stroke_width: "2",
        stroke_linecap: "round",
        stroke_linejoin: "round",
        aria_hidden: "true",
        class: "ml-auto rtl:rotate-180"
      ) { |s| s.path(d: "m9 18 6-6-6-6") }
    end

    # The ids come from the DropdownMenuSub around it, known only while
    # rendering. They win over a caller's id:, so the submenu's
    # aria-labelledby always points here.
    def with_sub_ids(given)
      id = context[:ruby_ui_dropdown_menu_sub]
      return given unless id

      given.merge(id: "#{id}-trigger", aria: (given[:aria] || {}).merge(controls: "#{id}-content"))
    end

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "menuitem",
        tabindex: "-1",
        aria: {
          haspopup: "menu",
          expanded: "false",
          disabled: (@disabled ? "true" : nil)
        },
        data: {
          slot: "dropdown-menu-sub-trigger",
          inset: @inset,
          disabled: @disabled,
          action: "click->ruby-ui--dropdown-menu#toggleSub pointermove->ruby-ui--dropdown-menu#hover pointerleave->ruby-ui--dropdown-menu#leave"
        },
        class: [
          "flex cursor-default items-center gap-2 rounded-sm px-2 py-1.5 text-sm outline-hidden select-none",
          "focus:bg-accent focus:text-accent-foreground not-data-[variant=destructive]:focus:**:text-accent-foreground",
          "data-popup-open:bg-accent data-popup-open:text-accent-foreground",
          "data-disabled:pointer-events-none data-disabled:opacity-50 data-inset:pl-8",
          "[&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4"
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Wraps the element that opens the menu (usually a Button). The wrapper is
  # display: contents; the controller puts aria-haspopup, aria-expanded,
  # aria-controls and data-slot="dropdown-menu-trigger" on the button inside,
  # the element shadcn's trigger renders.
  class DropdownMenuTrigger < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {
          ruby_ui__dropdown_menu_target: "trigger",
          action: "click->ruby-ui--dropdown-menu#toggle"
        },
        class: "contents"
      }
    end
  end
end

docs_markdown:
# Dropdown Menu

Displays a menu to the user — such as a set of actions or functions — triggered by a button.

## Usage

### Basic

```ruby
DropdownMenu do
  DropdownMenuTrigger do
    Button(variant: :outline) { "Open" }
  end
  DropdownMenuContent do
    DropdownMenuGroup do
      DropdownMenuLabel { "My Account" }
      DropdownMenuItem { "Profile" }
      DropdownMenuItem { "Billing" }
      DropdownMenuItem { "Settings" }
    end
    DropdownMenuSeparator()
    DropdownMenuItem { "GitHub" }
    DropdownMenuItem { "Support" }
    DropdownMenuItem(disabled: true) { "API" }
  end
end
```

### With shortcuts

```ruby
DropdownMenu do
  DropdownMenuTrigger do
    Button(variant: :outline) { "Open" }
  end
  DropdownMenuContent(class: "w-56") do
    DropdownMenuGroup do
      DropdownMenuLabel { "My Account" }
      DropdownMenuItem do
        plain "Profile"
        DropdownMenuShortcut { "⇧⌘P" }
      end
      DropdownMenuItem do
        plain "Billing"
        DropdownMenuShortcut { "⌘B" }
      end
      DropdownMenuItem do
        plain "Settings"
        DropdownMenuShortcut { "⌘S" }
      end
    end
    DropdownMenuSeparator()
    DropdownMenuItem do
      plain "Log out"
      DropdownMenuShortcut { "⇧⌘Q" }
    end
  end
end
```

### Submenu

```ruby
DropdownMenu do
  DropdownMenuTrigger do
    Button(variant: :outline) { "Open" }
  end
  DropdownMenuContent do
    DropdownMenuGroup do
      DropdownMenuItem { "Team" }
      DropdownMenuSub do
        DropdownMenuSubTrigger { "Invite users" }
        DropdownMenuSubContent do
          DropdownMenuItem { "Email" }
          DropdownMenuItem { "Message" }
          DropdownMenuSeparator()
          DropdownMenuItem { "More..." }
        end
      end
      DropdownMenuItem { "New Team" }
    end
  end
end
```

### Checkboxes

```ruby
DropdownMenu do
  DropdownMenuTrigger do
    Button(variant: :outline) { "Open" }
  end
  DropdownMenuContent(class: "w-40") do
    DropdownMenuGroup do
      DropdownMenuLabel { "Appearance" }
      DropdownMenuCheckboxItem(checked: true) { "Status Bar" }
      DropdownMenuCheckboxItem(disabled: true) { "Activity Bar" }
      DropdownMenuCheckboxItem { "Panel" }
    end
  end
end
```

### Radio group

```ruby
DropdownMenu do
  DropdownMenuTrigger do
    Button(variant: :outline) { "Open" }
  end
  DropdownMenuContent(class: "w-32") do
    DropdownMenuRadioGroup do
      DropdownMenuLabel { "Panel Position" }
      DropdownMenuRadioItem(value: "top") { "Top" }
      DropdownMenuRadioItem(value: "bottom", checked: true) { "Bottom" }
      DropdownMenuRadioItem(value: "right") { "Right" }
    end
  end
end
```

### Destructive

```ruby
DropdownMenu do
  DropdownMenuTrigger do
    Button(variant: :outline) { "Actions" }
  end
  DropdownMenuContent do
    DropdownMenuGroup do
      DropdownMenuItem { "Edit" }
      DropdownMenuItem { "Share" }
    end
    DropdownMenuSeparator()
    DropdownMenuItem(variant: :destructive) { "Delete" }
  end
end
```

### Inset

```ruby
DropdownMenu do
  DropdownMenuTrigger do
    Button(variant: :outline) { "Open" }
  end
  DropdownMenuContent(class: "w-44") do
    DropdownMenuGroup do
      DropdownMenuLabel(inset: true) { "Edit" }
      DropdownMenuItem(inset: true) { "Copy" }
      DropdownMenuItem(inset: true) { "Cut" }
    end
    DropdownMenuSeparator()
    DropdownMenuCheckboxItem(checked: true) { "Word Wrap" }
  end
end
```

### Links

```ruby
DropdownMenu do
  DropdownMenuTrigger do
    Button(variant: :outline) { "Open" }
  end
  DropdownMenuContent do
    DropdownMenuItem(href: "#links") { "Documentation" }
    DropdownMenuItem(href: "#links") { "Changelog" }
  end
end
```

### Opening a dialog

```ruby
DropdownMenu do
  DropdownMenuTrigger do
    Button(variant: :outline) { "Open" }
  end
  DropdownMenuContent do
    DropdownMenuItem { "Edit" }
    DropdownMenuItem(variant: :destructive) do
      Dialog do
        DialogTrigger(class: "w-full text-left") { "Delete" }
        DialogContent do
          DialogHeader do
            DialogTitle { "Are you absolutely sure?" }
            DialogDescription { "This action cannot be undone." }
          end
          DialogFooter do
            Button(variant: :destructive, data: {action: "click->ruby-ui--dialog#dismiss"}) { "Delete" }
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
```

### Side and align

```ruby
div(class: "grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-4") do
  %i[top right bottom left].each do |side|
    DropdownMenu do
      DropdownMenuTrigger do
        Button(variant: :outline, class: "w-full") { side.to_s }
      end
      DropdownMenuContent(side: side, align: :center) do
        DropdownMenuItem { "Profile" }
        DropdownMenuItem { "Billing" }
        DropdownMenuItem { "Settings" }
      end
    end
  end
end
```

### Non-modal

```ruby
DropdownMenu(modal: false) do
  DropdownMenuTrigger do
    Button(variant: :outline) { "Open" }
  end
  DropdownMenuContent do
    DropdownMenuItem { "Profile" }
    DropdownMenuItem { "Billing" }
  end
end
```

Opening a dialog
examples.code:
DropdownMenu do
  DropdownMenuTrigger do
    Button(variant: :outline) { "Open" }
  end
  DropdownMenuContent do
    DropdownMenuItem { "Edit" }
    DropdownMenuItem(variant: :destructive) do
      Dialog do
        DialogTrigger(class: "w-full text-left") { "Delete" }
        DialogContent do
          DialogHeader do
            DialogTitle { "Are you absolutely sure?" }
            DialogDescription { "This action cannot be undone." }
          end
          DialogFooter do
            Button(variant: :destructive, data: {action: "click->ruby-ui--dialog#dismiss"}) { "Delete" }
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.title: Side and align
examples.code:
div(class: "grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-4") do
  %i[top right bottom left].each do |side|
    DropdownMenu do
      DropdownMenuTrigger do
        Button(variant: :outline, class: "w-full") { side.to_s }
      end
      DropdownMenuContent(side: side, align: :center) do
        DropdownMenuItem { "Profile" }
        DropdownMenuItem { "Billing" }
        DropdownMenuItem { "Settings" }
      end
    end
  end
end
